API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APIPartner IntegrationsGet Workload Discovery Settings
Get Workload Discovery Settings
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/discoveryService/workloadDiscoverySettings

Retrieves the workload discovery service settings.

Responses
​
default

Default response. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
trustedAccountId
string

The ID of the Zscaler AWS account that is required in the AWS trust policy.

trustedRoleName
string

The name of the trusted role in the Zscaler AWS account.
